name: Boss Level
lede: Four missions, about ten minutes each. This time you are the one who decides how a team uses AI: where to start, what the rules are, what it returned, and what ships. Jump to any mission in any order.
description: Level 5 of an interactive AI course for marketers: strategy, rules, proof of return, and a one-page AI workflow plan you can copy and use.

missions.name: Strategy Map
missions.hook: A team can try AI on a hundred things. The smart ones start with a few. Place six ideas on the map, then pick your first three.
missions.objective: Rank AI use cases by impact and risk, then choose the first three to try.

missions.name: Rules of the Road
missions.hook: Ten quick scenarios. Sort each one: fine, needs a human sign-off, or don't. Build a streak and read the reason after every card.
missions.objective: Sort real-world scenarios into fine, needs sign-off, or don't.

missions.name: Prove It
missions.hook: Someone will ask whether the AI is worth it. Build an honest number with a calculator, then try to break it.
missions.objective: Build an honest estimate of what an AI workflow is worth, and test where it could be wrong.

missions.name: Ship It
missions.hook: The capstone. Pick a campaign, fill in six boxes, and walk away with a clean one-page AI workflow plan you can hand to your team.
missions.objective: Write a one-page plan for a real AI workflow that your team can follow.

recap: Start where the impact is high and the risk is low. Earn the bigger bets.
Sort every use into fine, needs a human sign-off, or don't, and check your own policies.
Net value is time kept, minus review, rework, and tool cost. Count it honestly.
You wrote a one-page AI workflow plan with human checkpoints. Now run it.
next: That is the whole course. You have the prompts, the kit, the systems, and now the plan. Pick one real campaign this week and go ship something real.
